name: market-requester
description: Market network requester: one compute contract through RFP, bid, accept and cloud-init, released once the guest reports onNetwork, with no ssh session

plc-directory-url.description: PLC directory the requester registers its DID with and resolves the bidder through

ingress-proxy-host.description: XRPC dispatcher host:port the requester, bidder and guest share

bidder-dids.description: Comma-separated bidder DIDs to send the RFP to

guest-ca-file.description: PEM CA the guest's user_data adds to its trust store, for the dispatcher's TLS front

guest-curl-home.description: CURL_HOME the guest's systemd manager hands every unit, so units read the .curlrc the bidder writes there

guest-diagnose-url.description: URL the guest fetches verbosely at the end of cloud-init, its output in the console

guest-cloud-config-file.description: JSON cloud-config merged into the guest's base user_data: its bootcmd, runcmd and write_files entries are appended, any other key is set

guest-journal-to-console.description: Have the guest's journal forwarded to its serial console, so its units' output lands in the console the bidder keeps

vm-ready-timeout-sec.description: How long to wait for the guest to report onNetwork

result-file.description: Where the JSON verdict is written

control-dir.description: Hold the contract after onNetwork: write onnetwork.json (and terminated.json when the bidder reports vm.terminated) here, and send vm.delete only once a file named release appears, even after a vm.terminated
